model.name: ISO/IEC 25010:2023
model.note: Project-defined criteria organized by nine product-quality characteristics, not a reproduction of the standard or formal ISO conformity assessment.

scope: ECHOREPO repository, portal, API and supporting services; independent mobile application and external platforms require separate owner evidence where applicable.

status_definitions.SUPPORTED: Existing evidence supports the stated bounded criterion; not an ISO pass or formal acceptance.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some evidence exists; important part of the criterion remains unverified.
status_definitions.NOT_ASSESSED: No adequate measured or direct evidence yet.
status_definitions.SCOPE_REVIEW: Applicability or requirement scope requires agreement.

R71.note: Project-supplied R7-1 evidence archive; 77/77 mapped checks per supplied Phase 4 report dated 2026-11-23. Archive not independently reopened during this review.

CI.note: Successful isolated CI run, 2026-11-22; separate from the 77 mapped-check denominator.

criteria.subject: Core portal and data API
criteria.criterion: Verify mapped functionality and representative user journeys.
criteria.assessment: R7-1 reported mapped results support defined functionality, not every product requirement.
criteria.next_action: Review agreed requirements and scope, including mobile app ownership.

criteria.subject: Canonical data correctness
criteria.criterion: Validate six resource schemas, types, keys and consistent counts on a dated snapshot.
criteria.assessment: Saved bundle validation and synthetic contract tests passed within their scope.
criteria.next_action: Retain bundle hash, per-rule counts and validation report; quantify missingness and domain QA in Phase 2.

criteria.subject: Soil and biodiversity processing
criteria.criterion: Verify transformations, laboratory joins, controlled imports and publication preparation.
criteria.assessment: Mapped tests and separate pilot publication support capability; full-volume scientific fidelity and ingestion provenance not established by them.
criteria.next_action: Collect representative data-quality checks and operational import evidence; clarify Firebase scope.

criteria.subject: Interactive response time
criteria.criterion: Measure sequential HTTP response latency for health, count, pagination, search, public pages and map data.
criteria.assessment: No R7-3 measurements collected yet.
criteria.next_action: Phase 2: record sample count, median, p95, maximum, errors and response bytes; approve operation-specific targets before measurements.

criteria.subject: Export throughput
criteria.criterion: Measure elapsed time, output size and throughput for representative canonical exports.
criteria.assessment: R7-1 establishes preparation, not measured speed.
criteria.next_action: Phase 2: use bounded/approved export workloads, record snapshot and environment.

criteria.subject: Resource use and capacity
criteria.criterion: Document CPU, peak RSS, disk, workload size and processing time for large biodiversity tasks.
criteria.assessment: Streaming and resource limits are documented; actual capacity limits are unmeasured in this assessment.
criteria.next_action: Retain existing dated benchmark logs if available; perform controlled dev benchmarks, not production stress tests.

criteria.subject: Internal service integration
criteria.criterion: Check REST API/database, OIDC discovery, object storage and export interfaces.
criteria.assessment: Ten reported integration checks passed against production observations with staging opt-in; no claim of full staging acceptance.
criteria.next_action: Record exact environment and test dates; retain original XML evidence.

criteria.subject: Zenodo data publication
criteria.criterion: Confirm version-specific records, file inventory and preparation workflow.
criteria.assessment: Project reports canonical and pilot publications; dry run checks preparation, not upload or record equality. Pilot files may be restricted.
criteria.next_action: Retain public metadata/file listings and publication logs; verify links in Phase 4.

criteria.subject: SoilWise and European Data Portal discovery
criteria.criterion: Confirm exact record/DOI discoverability and distinguish metadata parsing.
criteria.assessment: Project-observed catalogue links exist; downstream CSVW parsing and JRC/EUSO indexing remain unverified.
criteria.next_action: Retain dated record captures and SoilWise reply; establish applicable requirements for JRC/EUSO.

criteria.subject: External data consumption
criteria.criterion: Confirm LOESS overlay behavior and provenance.
criteria.assessment: Conversion and localization tested; live refresh and end-to-end data provenance not established here.
criteria.next_action: Collect dated refresh status, source link and screenshot of active overlay if applicable.

criteria.subject: Navigation, search and map
criteria.criterion: Exercise public map, filtering, pagination and authenticated navigation in real browser.
criteria.assessment: Reported browser checks passed for these journeys.
criteria.next_action: Retain browser evidence and describe tested browser/device context.

criteria.subject: Localization and responsiveness
criteria.criterion: Check locale switching and mobile viewport; review accessibility.
criteria.assessment: Spanish locale and one mobile layout checked; not a cross-browser or accessibility audit.
criteria.next_action: Review representative keyboard navigation, contrast and labels; test additional browser/device combinations as appropriate.

criteria.subject: User experience and satisfaction
criteria.criterion: Collect anonymous responses from people who have used ECHOREPO.
criteria.assessment: No existing survey is known to project operator; no satisfaction estimate.
criteria.next_action: Phase 5: use draft survey protocol; report denominator, recruitment, dates and response distribution.

criteria.subject: Co-design feedback and improvements
criteria.criterion: Document dated workshops or task-based feedback and resulting design changes.
criteria.assessment: No workshop evidence supplied in this review.
criteria.next_action: Request relevant project records or organize a new documented feedback session; do not relabel it as a historical workshop.

criteria.subject: Operational availability
criteria.criterion: Measure availability over a defined observation interval and summarize incidents.
criteria.assessment: Point-in-time service checks passed; uptime is not established.
criteria.next_action: Obtain existing monitoring aggregates and incident history; define observation window.

criteria.subject: Data integrity and recoverability
criteria.criterion: Check snapshot integrity and demonstrate restore/recovery on disposable environment.
criteria.assessment: Snapshot validator, storage and migration tests support integrity; backup restore and disaster recovery not demonstrated.
criteria.next_action: Verify backup/restore procedure using disposable dev data; record recovery outcomes and limitations.

criteria.subject: Failure handling
criteria.criterion: Assess safe behavior on malformed requests and dependency loss.
criteria.assessment: Input handling tested; session fail-closed and import rollback documented; no deployment fault injection evidence.
criteria.next_action: Review failure modes and test selected failures in development only.

criteria.subject: Authentication and access control
criteria.criterion: Verify Keycloak discovery, protected API routes, safe redirects and authorized browser access.
criteria.assessment: Mapped checks support bounded authentication/access behaviors; no full authorization audit.
criteria.next_action: Phase 3: check actual deployed HTTPS login and role boundaries with authorized test accounts.

criteria.subject: Session confidentiality
criteria.criterion: Verify opaque server-side session implementation and production cookie/configuration behavior.
criteria.assessment: Unit checks support implementation; rollout document describes optional configuration; database stores sensitive token data.
criteria.next_action: Confirm actual deployed session backend and cookie flags without collecting token or cookie values; verify expiry/revocation in controlled tests.

criteria.subject: Transport and security headers
criteria.criterion: Inspect TLS validity, HTTPS redirects and relevant response headers.
criteria.assessment: Deployment settings alone do not verify edge configuration.
criteria.next_action: Phase 3: conservative public HTTPS checks; record header presence and context, not secrets.

criteria.subject: Data privacy and least privilege
criteria.criterion: Check public field suppression, coordinate jitter and role-separated private resources.
criteria.assessment: Selected privacy controls tested; not a GDPR or complete authorization assessment.
criteria.next_action: Review canonical exports, private routes, logs, retention and consent; use synthetic users and aggregate results.

criteria.subject: Dependency and source security
criteria.criterion: Audit installed dependencies, static code findings and configuration defaults.
criteria.assessment: No current vulnerability audit or secret-management review collected. Compose includes a development-style fallback DB password; actual deployed value is unknown.
criteria.next_action: Run pip-audit on recorded environment, Bandit/static review and config review; triage findings without publishing secrets.

criteria.subject: Regression testing and traceability
criteria.criterion: Check that test code, criteria, CI and results are versioned and reproducible.
criteria.assessment: Repository contains tests, explicit matrices, CI and consolidation tooling; 18/19 components have isolated passing tests.
criteria.next_action: Record test revision versus deployment revision; retain evidence archive; expand tests when requirements change.

criteria.subject: Modularity and documentation
criteria.criterion: Review service separation, API guidance, migration and publication documentation.
criteria.assessment: Source and runbooks exist; no measured maintainability review; older architecture overview may not match current implementation.
criteria.next_action: Review representative code and documentation consistency, technical debt and release process.

criteria.subject: Deployment and configuration
criteria.criterion: Review Docker deployment variants, environment-specific controls and database migrations.
criteria.assessment: Deployment/configuration artifacts exist; portability and repeatable installation not demonstrated here.
criteria.next_action: Reproduce a clean dev deployment or retain documented deployment checks; avoid production changes.

criteria.subject: Scalability and extensibility
criteria.criterion: Review bounded-memory processing, batch import and optional research services.
criteria.assessment: Designed for configurable workflows and optional services; no measured scalability guarantee.
criteria.next_action: Record workload/resource measurements in Phase 2; identify practical scaling constraints.

criteria.subject: Data integrity and safe failure
criteria.criterion: Identify consequential failures such as incorrect soil results, data loss or exposing sensitive records; review safeguards.
criteria.assessment: Relevant safeguards exist and some are tested; safety-specific risk assessment not completed.
criteria.next_action: Review data-use limitations, failure modes and escalation paths with scientific and technical owners; no claim of safety certification.

criteria.subject: Applicability and scientific interpretation
criteria.criterion: Determine whether safety-specific operational constraints or warnings apply to intended use.
criteria.assessment: Repository is a research data service, not assumed to be safety-critical; soil estimates may be misinterpreted.
criteria.next_action: Confirm scope with reviewer; record limitations, warnings and rationale for any criteria considered not applicable.

target_status: WP2 suggested target; not independently established as contractual
notes: R7-1: 49/49 mapped automated tests, 10/10 integration checks and 18/18 browser checks (77/77) per supplied Phase 4 report; 18/19 isolated-component coverage. These numbers are not an R7-3 score.
No new live probes, benchmarks, vulnerability scans, user surveys or production changes were performed in Phase 1.
Do not treat SUPPORTED criteria as formal acceptance; update after dated evidence is collected.
